capabilities: Load TeX macros (\newcommand, \def, \DeclareMathOperator) from one .md, .tex or .sty file into the MathJax engine
Reload the macro file from the command palette or settings and redraw open Reading views
Show notices for missing files, bad definitions, and rejected package commands
Define and switch named macro libraries (Pro)
Preview a library's definitions with sample expansions and errors (Pro)
extras: Freemium: core features are free; named libraries and library preview require a GitHub Sponsors payment ($5/month or $15 total) and sign-in via the GitHub device flow, which sends only profile-scope queries to GitHub. After updates the plugin opens a What's new tab promoting other NoteMods plugins and Zovo Chat. The README notes untested areas: real phones/tablets (only an emulated phone window), other Obsidian versions, large macro files, Live Preview refresh, and conflicts with other math-engine plugins. Removed definitions stay usable until restart.
problem: Obsidian's math engine has no built-in way to define custom TeX commands once and reuse them across all notes, so writers repeat macro definitions or paste them into each note.

requires.name: GitHub Sponsors sponsorship of theluckystrike ($5/month or $15 total) for Pro features

summary: Loads TeX macro definitions from one vault file into Obsidian's MathJax engine so every note can use the same math commands.
